title: VergeSense Revolutionizing Workplace Efficiency with Occupancy Intelligence
summary: Discover how VergeSense leverages unified occupancy data and AI‑powered Workplace Assistant to optimize space, cut costs, and improve workplace experience.
body_markdown:
By: CompanyGlance


CompanyGlance spotlights how VergeSense is transforming workplace efficiency through its unified Occupancy Intelligence Platform. By consolidating real-time sensor, WiFi, and booking data, VergeSense enables corporate real estate and facilities teams to optimize space usage, reduce operational costs, and enhance employee experience. Its latest generative AI tool, Workplace Assistant, delivers bespoke insights and recommendations in minutes—facilitating smarter, data-driven decisions across hybrid enterprises.


[Read More](https://companyglance.com/news/vergesense-revolutionizing-workplace-efficiency-with-occupancy-intelligence/)
